summary: The host names each column's place in a list row, so a list of resources draws its status, title, supporting line and facts from the host's columns.

then.note: Every column carries one of the five places. In a list row: the state is a dot (ok, warning, error, stopped, or the dot's own names) whose word is its tooltip; the name is the record's link; domain and kind are joined with « · » into the second line, in column order; ssl and backup are unlabelled badges in columns of one width, quiet when fine and warning or error when the value says so ({text, status, tip}); notes is left out. The table draws every column as before: list changes the list row only.
